note: LibreOffice application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application commands (File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help) and their submenus
LibreOffice toolbars -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for standard application controls (Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, formatting, and function buttons)
LibreOffice status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for application state indicators (page number, zoom level, selection info, and mode)
Sheet tab list -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for the default sheet name ('Sheet1') in a new document
